tweets.text:
Following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine three years ago, President Biden rallied the world to support Ukraine’s defense, standing up for freedom and democracy everywhere.

This week, President Biden announced a significant new security assistance for Ukraine, which will support Ukraine’s defense now and over the long-term. Our assistance – authorized and appropriated by Congress – has been critical to Ukraine’s battlefield success defending its independence, while strengthening the U.S. defense industrial base and modernizing our defense capabilities here at home.

And, President Biden has built a coalition of more than 50 countries to support the people of Ukraine, providing aid that has helped Ukraine protect its people from Russia’s brutal attacks. He has worked with allies and partners to impose unprecedented costs against Russia to cut off funding for their war machine and hold them accountable for their aggression against Ukraine.

President Biden’s leadership has strengthened Ukraine’s position, so that Ukraine enters any future negotiations from a position of strength. This Administration will continue to support the Ukrainian people as they defend their freedom and independence.

tweets.text:
President Biden and the First Lady, as a military family, recognize the service and strength of military-connected families. Our service members shouldn’t have to choose between their love of our country and their love of family.
 
Dr. Biden, through her Joining Forces initiative, has worked to support military and veteran families by increasing economic opportunities for spouses, supporting the education of military-connected children, and focusing on health and wellness for caregivers and survivors. 
 
In 2023, President Biden, alongside Dr. Biden and military spouses at Fort Liberty, signed a historic Executive Order to support the careers of our military and veteran spouses, caregivers, and survivors. In addition, the President took action to improve child care and make long-term care more accessible and affordable for families, including our nation's military families. 
 
Meeting the economic, social, and emotional needs of our military and veteran families, caregivers, and survivors is a national security imperative.

tweets.text:
President Biden called New Orleans Mayor LaToya Cantrell this morning to offer full federal support following the horrific news that a driver killed and injured dozens of individuals in New Orleans overnight. 

He has been briefed on the latest developments by senior FBI and DHS leadership and his homeland security team, and he will continue to be briefed on this incident throughout the day. The FBI is investigating this incident as an act of terrorism and President Biden has directed his team to ensure every resource is available as law enforcement works to get to the bottom of what happened as quickly as possible and to ensure that there is no remaining threat of any kind.
